title: SB 452 (2025-2026 (136th General Assembly)): S. B. No. 452: Clarify only natural persons have the right to vote
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.

(e_other_rule)
(section) R.C. 3503.01(A)
(quote) Only a citizen of the United States who is a natural person of the age of eighteen years or over and who has been a resident of the state thirty days immediately preceding the election at which the citizen offers to vote, is a resident of the county and precinct in which the citizen offers to vote, and has been registered to vote for thirty days, has the qualifications of an elector and may vote at all elections in the precinct in which the citizen resides.
(section) R.C. 3503.01(A)
(quote) STRUCK: Every citizen
(other) note: Only change is 'Every citizen' becomes 'Only a citizen' and adds 'a natural person' (so only natural persons can vote). No ID, provisional ballot or proof-of-citizenship document rule. Division (B) reprinted unchanged. Sole version.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
